OBJECTIVE: Put real evidence under two records that the registry presents as read and the receipt ledger does not attest. PMID 30619736 and PMID 24932569, each taken to a durable verifiable reading — complete_fulltext_read where the surfaces permit it, honestly partial where they do not — with verbatim locators captured while the document is open, a schema-v2 manifest at strict PASS, a dossier, and a receipt through the validated writer.

WHY_THIS_LOT_EXISTS.the_distinction_that_defines_it: 🔴 DECLARED IS NOT ATTESTED. Both papers are recorded in the registry with a full-text declaration, and neither declaration rests on a reading anyone can check. This is not a bookkeeping matter: three consumers in this repository treat the registry sentence as a reading — coverage_report.py raises a paper to full_text depth on the bare string, session_self_eval.py CLEARS an unread premise when a PAPER block says 'full text reviewed', and the intake triage script reads no receipt surface at all. So a conclusion can lean on a paper nobody opened and every check stays green.
WHY_THIS_LOT_EXISTS.30619736: PAPER 032, status claim_linked, Evidence depth 'full text verificato' pointing at a staging path. It has NO receipt of any kind, and it is absent from reading_state.md — where a missing row is indistinguishable from no debt. It is the SOLE primary source of CLAIM 026.
WHY_THIS_LOT_EXISTS.24932569: PAPER 053, status background_only, declared 'full text reviewed (coverage_status: complete_fulltext_read)'. The only ledger event is a legacy reconstruction whose nine coverage keys are all unknown_legacy and whose source_locator points at the registry rather than at any article surface. The registry also calls it HIGH relevance for the haploinsufficiency argument.
WHY_THIS_LOT_EXISTS.what_was_already_searched_so_you_do_not_: The orchestrator searched this checkout and its git history for pre-existing artefacts of both papers before drafting this lot: no dossier, no manifest, no page adjudication and no receipt exists for either. Mentions of both PMIDs exist only inside OTHER papers' manifests and ledgers, as citations. The staging path named by PAPER 032 is not present in this checkout. Conclusion: there is nothing to reuse, and both are first contact with the text.
WHY_THIS_LOT_EXISTS.do_not_fabricate_a_retroactive_receipt: A documentary reconstruction is not a reading. Under framework/protocols/fulltext_read_receipt.md, first contact with the text after a legacy_reconstruction is first_read and NAMES the reconstruction it supersedes. For 30619736 there is no prior event at all, so it is a plain first_read.

SCIENTIFIC_QUESTIONS.30619736: What does this interactome study actually establish — in which cell system, by which method, with which controls and which statistical treatment — and what does CLAIM 026 ('WWOX may function as a trafficking-metabolism coupling node linking endomembrane systems with catabolic pathways converging on Acetyl-CoA') actually have under it once the source is read? Specifically: which interactors are supported by the primary data as opposed to by pathway-enrichment annotation, and is the metabolic coupling measured anywhere or inferred from enrichment?
SCIENTIFIC_QUESTIONS.24932569: It is a REVIEW. So the question is not what it found but what it is a faithful conduit for: which of its statements are its own synthesis, which are restatements of primaries, and — for the haploinsufficiency argument the registry rates HIGH — what primary evidence does it actually cite, and does that primary say what the review says it says? A review is read as a census of claims and their sources, never as a source of experimental fact.
SCIENTIFIC_QUESTIONS.joint: What, if anything, does the pair license about a trafficking-metabolism function of WWOX that a reader of the primaries alone would not accept?

RETRY_POLICY.on_exhaust: PARK that surface with the written cascade and each literal response, and continue with the rest of the paper and the other PMID. An inaccessible source is an explicit limit on corpus completeness, never a reason to stop the lot and never a reason to simulate a reading.

STOP_POLICY_REMINDER: §21c governs. Reserved and never yours: any push, history rewrite, deletion of unique material, external spend of any kind, modification of the four current files or disease_model.md, BATCH_COMMIT. Everything else has a safe default: take it, record it in DEFAULTS_TAKEN, continue. Closing your turn with a paper of your lot unworked is itself a class-3 stop; running out of context is the one honest reason to stop, said in one line as that reason.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: Supplementary File 2 of 30619736: its derived text surface is refused as SUSPECT by deepdive_manifest's screen (the tab-separated spectral-count triplet "7\t3\t10" read as a × substitution in scientific notation).
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Did not hand-correct and did not work around the screen. Declared the fingerprinted xlsx container instead, and carried every File 2 number as a named reproducible computation in the dossier rather than as a quote.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: The protocol forbids hand-correcting a surface and forbids a locator on a refused one. No conclusion rests on an unverifiable quote; the computation is reproducible from the declared container by the declared renderer.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_been_different: Quoting File 2 directly would have put load-bearing numbers on a surface the validator refuses.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: Supplementary Table 1 of 24932569 unreachable: Europe PMC "not open access one"; PMC /instance/bin/ returns a reCAPTCHA HTML page with and without -L; pmc_pow_fetch refuses that page; ?pdf=render returns 302 HTML.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Declared coverage supplementary=unavailable with the four literal responses recorded, and marked the PheGenI trait claim as uncheckable.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: An inaccessible source is an explicit limit on corpus completeness; the receipt stays honest and complete_fulltext_read still holds with unavailable.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_been_different: Claiming the supplement as read would have overstated coverage on the one claim that cannot be checked at all.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: No figure legend exists for any of the 11 figures of 24932569 (empty XML captions; PDF pages carry only "Figure N.").
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Read every figure as an image against the sentences that cite it, recorded the absence in each artefact note, and kept figures=read because the images were inspected.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: captions_only would misdescribe the work (the images WERE inspected); the absence is recorded where a reader meets it.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_been_different: Without the absence recorded, a later reader would assume a legend exists and trust a caption that does not.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: Testing the review's faithfulness required its cited primaries (refs 50, 51, 55), which are not in this lot.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Opened all three, declared each as a fingerprinted artefact with its route, quoted them only for the named statements, and claimed NO receipt and no complete read for any of them.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_been_different: Without them the three haploinsufficiency sentences could only have been restated, which is the failure this lot exists to end.
